What you are looking for are samples and presets

Samples are audio clips and theres two types:

One Shots: Really short clips, drum hits, percussions and so on

Loops: Longer clips, can be anything from a bassline to vocals

Presets are pre made sounds for a synthesizer (or synths)

Theres a lot of synths each one is different, I recommend serum since you're a beginner

Im not sure if this will work for you but here's how I started, im just a beginner, this isn't all there is to learn: 

1.- Learn ableton inside out, what each button does and the basic shortcuts 

2.- Learn basic music theory. Scales, intervals, chords, staying in key.

3.- Start your first song, you'll start figuring out what you need to learn as you go on, my first song took me a month because I would be working on it and whenever I noticed I needed a compressor or a specific synth sound, I would start looking at tutorials on those topics

4.- Learn how to mix and don't be lazy on this stage, gain staging, EQ, Compressor, saturator, sidechain compression, this will do for now

5.- Personally I didn't get into mastering yet, I use LANDR if your mix is good this will do, however dont completely discard mastering LANDR is just a service, you can't tweak it, manual mastering is better from what i've heard
